title: VISTA: Value-Informed Event Appraisal for Multimodal Emotion Conflict
abstract: arXiv:2609.37324v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conflicting emotional cues can be individually valid: a subdued voice may reflect a blocked goal while a smile satisfies a social obligation. Their interpretation depends on what the event means to the person. We introduce VISTA (Value-Informed Semantic Trust Arbitration), a learned seven-field appraisal interface that conditions modality arbitration on concerns, event relations, and expression conditions while retaining a joint-evidence residual. A log-odds decomposition separates emotion expectation from cue diagnosticity, motivating an interface that lets appraisal change how evidence is interpreted. With a shared Qwen2.5-Omni-7B backbone and matched training examples and steps, VISTA reaches 64.5% conflict accuracy on CA-MER, improving on modality gating by 2.5 percentage points on conflict and 0.2 on consistency. translated_title: VISTA：面向多模态情绪冲突的价值知情事件评价
translated_abstract: 相互冲突的情绪线索可能各自都是有效的：低沉的声音可能反映了受阻的目标，而微笑则可能只是在履行社会义务。对这些线索的解读取决于事件对当事人意味着什么。我们提出了VISTA（价值知情语义信任仲裁），这是一个可学习的七字段评价接口，它使模态仲裁以关注点、事件关系和表达条件为条件，同时保留联合证据残差。通过对数几率分解将情绪期望与线索诊断性分离开来，由此设计的接口使评价过程能够改变证据的解读方式。在共享的Qwen2.5-Omni-7B骨干网络以及匹配的训练样本和训练步数下，VISTA在CA-MER数据集上达到了64.5%的冲突准确率，相比模态门控方法在冲突场景上提升了2.5个百分点，在一致性场景上提升了0.2个百分点。若将评价信息在场景间打乱或移除其决策连接，这一收益则会降低。一个共同的冻结骨干……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: VISTA提出了一种可学习的七字段价值知情事件评价接口，让多模态情绪识别能够根据事件对当事人的意义来仲裁相互冲突的情绪线索，在CA-MER数据集上将冲突准确率提升至64.5%，超过模态门控方法2.5个百分点。
en_tdlr: VISTA introduces a learned seven-field value-informed event appraisal interface that arbitrates conflicting multimodal emotional cues based on what the event means to the person, achieving 64.5% conflict accuracy on CA-MER and outperforming modality gating by 2.5 percentage points.
